title: Repository and secure infrastructure
exit: Pinned lockfiles, migrations, synthetic fixtures, contract checks, RLS tests, audit/outbox and CI all pass in an isolated environment.

title: Institution identity and delegated access
exit: Unverified applicant can submit only own application; independent verification and scoped membership work; no cross-tenant read/write or self-elevation.

title: Programme and study review
exit: Programme and study drafts, exact snapshot review, independent people, conflicts and version races pass source acceptance cases.

title: Governed data and resumable ingestion
exit: Purpose-bound grants, verified chunks, resume, expiry, cancellation, quarantine and count reconciliation pass; no premature output exposure.

title: Retrospective evaluation execution
exit: Pinned protocol/configuration, approved methods, isolated execution, budget admission and complete failure accounting pass.

title: Independent evidence and institutional services
exit: Immutable evidence, separate public release, report correction, scoped analytics and commercial independence pass.

title: First release operations and closure
exit: Safety intake and containment remain available; recovery, retention, support, audit and full R1 nonfunctional gates pass.

title: Later release capability expansion
exit: Only source R2/R3 requirements; local prospective/deployment/GenAI/monitoring gates and additional contracts validated before activation.
